boundary_definition.internal_accepted_mutation: Subject Graph mutation committed via SubjectTransaction (CAS on subject_expected_revision, idempotency, CapabilityLease atomically consumed, Event Log evidence) in its own DB transaction
boundary_definition.external_authority_effect: Portable Plan authority-store mutation (Issue body or Plan document) applied via Plan Authority Adapter (GitHub or future store) with optimistic raw preconditions, at-most-one attempt, readback, deterministic reconciliation
boundary_definition.atomicity_claim: No transaction spans both stores; distributed atomic transaction is denied

mechanical_boundary_sequence: validate existing semantic authorization (D5 trusted auth differs from lease; lease issuer is not semantic decision maker)
read current external raw authority (load via PlanAuthorityReadAdapter)
validate expected authority revision/digest against authorized precondition (raw_source_revision + observed_raw_digest)
compare to authorized precondition; stale raw precondition fails closed (no last-write-wins)
construct exact intended candidate and compute candidate_raw_digest and normalized_plan_digest
persist PREPARED journal record durably (mandatory; fail closed if persistence fails → no external write)
persist APPLYING attempt-start durably (mandatory; external write forbidden until durably persisted)
perform at most one external mutation attempt via Plan Authority Mutation Port (generic, executor-neutral)
read authority store after mutation where result permits (mandatory verify-after-write)
classify exact observed state (three-way raw identity comparison)
persist terminal (VERIFIED / FAILED_NO_EFFECT) or reconciliation state (OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → RECONCILING → VERIFIED_RECOVERED / RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT / CONFLICT)
